explication: Neuro SAN Studio is a multi-agent orchestration studio for designing, configuring, running, and integrating collaborative agent networks. The principal workflow is: a user invokes the CLI or Slack interface, a network is discovered/imported and validated from HOCON, the Neuro SAN runtime delegates work across agents and tools, and results return through the initiating interface. Persistence, memory, RAG, external tools, and tracing form supporting layers. Several runtime links are inferred from documented capabilities because their implementations were not sampled.
